{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: pyusb

on: [push, pull_request]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      matrix:
        platform: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        python-version: ['3.9', '3.10', '3.11', '3.12', '3.13', '3.14']

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        cache: 'pip'
        cache-dependency-path: '**/tox.ini'
    - name: Install Python dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install setuptools>=30.3.0 tox
    - name: Install libusb-1.0 (Windows)
      if: startsWith(matrix.platform, 'windows-')
      shell: pwsh
      run: |
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://github.com/libusb/libusb/releases/download/v1.0.24/libusb-1.0.24.7z -OutFile libusb-1.0.24.7z
        7z e libusb-1.0.24.7z -oC:\Windows\System32 VS2019/MS64/dll/libusb-1.0.dll
    - name: Install libusb-1.0 (macos)
      if: startsWith(matrix.platform, 'macos-')
      run: |
        brew install libusb
    - id: pyver2toxenv
      run: |
        python -c "import sys; print('::set-output name=toxenv::py' + sys.argv[1].replace('.', ''))" ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    - name: Test with tox
      run: tox -e ${{ steps.pyver2toxenv.outputs.toxenv }}",
  "rationale": "Applied three evidence-supported optimizations: (1) Added pip dependency caching via setup-python's built-in cache (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) to avoid repeated downloads; (2) Added workflow-level concurrency with cancel-in-progress to supersede stale runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE); (3) Added a 30-minute job timeout to bound runaway executions (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT). All changes preserve the full matrix coverage and required test steps.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
